sql.description: The Truvio Commerce brand catalogue for SHOP1/ENU/EUR: 4 top groups x 3 subgroups (16 EcomGroups), 60 masters TCPROD0001..0060 with SKU TC-<CONCEPT>-<nnnn>, the Tier and Mode variant axes on 6 masters (36 combination rows, each with its own EcomPrices row), 1 BOM kit with 2 slots, 2 services, a 3-step quantity-tier ladder, one contract price scoped to customer number TC-100200, and 4 product categories x 7 category fields with 180 populated values. Every name is drawn from PIM/Commerce/CMS vocabulary (owner decision D-B); every key is TC*-prefixed and disjoint from sample-data's FIXT* and the feature families' PACK*.

costHints.reservedKeyNote: The TC* family this layer owns, disjoint from sample-data's FIXT* / FIXTGRP* / FIXT-PRICE-* (base.contract.json idRules.reservedFixtureKeys) and from the feature families' PACK-<NAME>-* prefix. Recorded here until the next base release adds it to idRules.reservedFixtureKeys.
costHints.expectedRowsNote: What truvio-catalog.sql lands on top of whatever sample-data seeds. Advisory: the gate derives its own counts from the composition, this is the layer's own statement of what it ships.
